item.tib: skyabs gnas spyi 'dus kyi rtsa sgrub bla ma mchod pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i dbang chog byin rlabs mngon 'jug
item.coloph: zhes skyabs gnas spyi 'dus kyi rtsa bsgrab bla ma mchod pa'i dbang chog byin rlabs dngos 'jug 'di yang / rgyal ba gong ma'i zhal rgyun dang rgyud sde chen po'i nang la mi 'dug bsam pa ma zad/ rang 'dra'i blo dman thos chung rnams la phan phyir/ khyung dkar ru'i sprang 'khyams po grub ming 'bod pas gang dran yin pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
